VI.description: Save and then close the project that is ACTIVE in the IDE, releasing it and its members from memory. Reached through Application:Project:Active Project, whose {LV.Project} class the VI Server catalogue does not list at all - both Save and Close were found by probing with ValidateAIXML against a negative control. Save runs first because Close carries NO save parameter, so an unsaved project would risk a modal prompt, and a modal dialog stops the whole gRPC service until a human dismisses it.\0A\0ATHE PROJECT REFERENCE IS CLOSED (uid 45), OUT OF THE ERROR CHAIN. It was leaked until 2026-09-07, which breaks this repository's own rule that a leaked refnum keeps its object in LabVIEW's memory - the exact mechanism that made lvai_create_class produce parentless children. Closing it is copied from lvai_active_project.vi, which has always closed the same reference cleanly, so the operation itself is proven. Error in is wired FOR ORDERING ONLY and error out is dropped, the pattern lvai_create_class.vi uses at uid 88: after Close the reference may legitimately be invalid, and consuming that error would turn every successful project close into a failed run.\0A\0AWHAT THIS DOES NOT FIX\2C MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. A 33-minute class build on 2026-09-07 left 38 new DWarn entries in NI's log\2C every one tagged [Executing\3A lvai_close_active_project.vi] - 15 DestroyPlatformEvent failed with MgErr 42\2C 3 bad parent in MoveItem\2C 1 Terminate thread failed. An A/B the same day built the pre-fix helper (this AIXML with uid 45 removed) and alternated the two over four closes in the same state\3A 0\2C 2\2C 1\2C 0 DestroyPlatformEvent warnings\2C pre-fix and fixed alike. INDISTINGUISHABLE - the refnum close neither causes nor cures them\2C and after round 2 alone the reading was 'the fix causes them'\2C which two more rounds refuted. bad parent in MoveItem did not reproduce once in those four closes\2C so it depends on what LabVIEW has in MEMORY rather than on this diagram - most likely the Save above\2C which makes LabVIEW adopt every VI it has open into the project. So uid 45 is kept on the refnum rule alone. docs/labview-crash-signatures.md.
